citation: Mosquera-Lopez E, et al. Eur J Appl Physiol 2025;126:1021
protocol: 90 min cycling at 60% of VO2max with taste-matched placebo drink (PLA arm; KME arm to ignore) then 3 h recovery; VO2, HR, lactate at rest and every 15 min of exercise; other metabolites and hormones across recovery
population: 9 recreationally active men, 26 +/- 5 y, VO2max 47 +/- 4 mL/kg/min
note: Long moderate bout with VO2 and power dose from measured VO2max; read PLA rows only. Glucose and hormone values for the recovery period should be looked for in the text and figures.
